inputs.text: In southern Alberta, a group called Water Not Coal, founded by Corb Lund only last month, is gathering signatures for a petition designed to make the Government of Alberta “prohibit through legislation all coal exploration.” They are doing this under the pretense of protecting the watershed, but it's really an attempt by activists to halt responsible resource development in the name of the environment. This approach elevates progressive ideas above the jobs, family stability, and economic strength that coal and energy industries have long provided in Alberta. It's vital that we uphold tradition and authority and prevent these kinds of petitions from weakening our control over our own resources.
